note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a No provision; A06b No provision; L05 No provision): no ordinary naturalisation by residence; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Group restriction: only if citizen parent is member of a particular group, race or religion), A01b (descent, born abroad: Group restriction: only if citizen parent is member of a particular group, race or religion), A02a (birth in country: Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a restriction to members of a particular group, which the form holds only in the condition's words, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.
